description: This file is a shell script containing performance test procedures for the 'fsmonitor' feature in Git. It sets up repositories, manages the FSMonitor daemon, executes performance tests, and performs cleanup operations.

methods.name: enable_uc
methods.description: Enables untracked cache in the specified Git repository.

methods.name: disable_uc
methods.description: Disables untracked cache in the specified Git repository.

methods.name: start_fsm
methods.description: Starts the FSMonitor daemon and enables FSMonitor in the repository.

methods.name: stop_fsm
methods.description: Stops the FSMonitor daemon and disables FSMonitor in the repository.

methods.name: do_status
methods.description: Runs 'git status' in the repository, timing the operation for performance measurement.

methods.name: do_matrix
methods.description: Performs a series of operations with different configurations of untracked cache and FSMonitor, including setup, modifications, staging, committing, and cleanup for benchmarking.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the test repository by deleting branches and resetting state.
